purpose: Track discoverable lexical, dictionary, language, and programming-language resources with provenance and explicit validation states.

resources.name: Kaikki / Wiktionary structured lexical data
resources.coverage: Multilingual; coverage differs by language and entry type
resources.import_policy: Record source dump date, language code, license, attribution, parser version, and checksum before importing.

resources.name: Princeton WordNet
resources.import_policy: Preserve version, license, source identifiers, and semantic relation types.

resources.name: Open Multilingual Wordnet
resources.coverage: Multiple languages; per-resource coverage and licensing vary
resources.import_policy: Track each language resource independently; do not assume one license applies to all.

resources.name: UniMorph
resources.import_policy: Keep language identifiers, feature schema, dataset revision, and provenance.

resources.name: Unicode Common Locale Data Repository
resources.coverage: Locale-oriented data, not a general dictionary
resources.import_policy: Use versioned locale data; keep locale IDs and Unicode versions.

resources.name: Unicode Character Database
resources.coverage: Unicode code points and properties; not a word dictionary
resources.import_policy: Version data and test normalization, combining marks, scripts, and supplementary planes.

resources.name: Wikidata Lexemes
resources.import_policy: Respect licensing, attribution, entity IDs, revisions, and incomplete records.

resources.name: GitHub Linguist language definitions
resources.coverage: Languages recognized by Linguist; not all programming languages ever created
resources.import_policy: Pin source revision and distinguish detected languages from a complete historical language census.

resources.name: Project-owned multilingual code benchmark registry
resources.coverage: Only languages with a defined compiler/interpreter and reproducible harness
resources.import_policy: Use original or permissively licensed tasks; record task license, expected output, timeout, resource limits, and test provenance.

resources.name: NEXORA language specification and built-in vocabulary
resources.coverage: Project language; only the implemented specification is authoritative
resources.import_policy: Generate keyword and builtin registries from the language specification where possible; test lexer/parser agreement.
